comments.text:
17:40 I think it is important to mention that her family now gets a veto right for every single study proposal that uses the HeLa cells. Or, at least, all above-board proposals.

If you want a non-US story, I have two.

1) Most of what we know about how the human body reacts to cold was figured out by German scientists in late 1930's and early 1940's. Guess who the test subjects were.

2) A study conducted at Vipeholm Hospital for the intellectually disabled in Lund, Sweden finally concluded, once and for all, that sugar intake leads to tooth decay. Guess who the test subjects were.

Both of these gave humanity extremely valuable knowledge that is used every day to great effect. But at the same time it is important to recognize that the studies themselves were highly unethical.
